items.title: Das DT 1770 Pro MKII kann mit dem MKI, klanglich leider nicht ganz mithalten.
items.comment:
Diese Kopfhörer haben einen schönen Bass, und sind insgesamt grundsätzlich Lautstärker. Allerdings klingen Stimmen und einige Tonfrequenzen schriller und tendieren zu einem dosenhafteren Klang.
MKI leistet hierbei eine um Längen bessere Arbeit, der Bass ist bei MKI minimal schwächer, dafür glänzt MKI in den meisten anderen Punkten deutlich mehr.
Ob MKII langlebiger ist, wegen des niedrigeren Ohms bleibt abzuwarten.
MKII wirkt klanglich wie ein 200€ Kopfhörer. Das Gehäuse und die Polster sind zweifelsfrei hervorragend!
Ach und bitte überprüft mal eure Verpackungsabteilung. Wenn Kartonagen zu klein für zwei Kopfhörerverpackungen gleichzeitig sind, dann sind sie nunmal eben zu klein und da wirkt es alles andere als Professionell, 10 Streifen mehr Paketband zu verwenden!

Falls Sie weitere Anmerkungen oder Rückfragen an unsere Produkte oder unseren Service haben, können Sie sich jederzeit an unsere Kollegen aus dem Support via help@beyerdynamic.de wenden. Diese stehen Ihnen gerne zur Verfügung.

items.title: Beeindruckender Sound trifft auf erstklassigen Komfort
items.comment: Die DT 1770 PRO MKII überzeugen mit einem beeindruckend klaren, detailreichen Klang und einer perfekten Balance aus satten Bässen, präsenten Mitten und brillanten Höhen. Der Tragekomfort ist erstklassig – weiche Polster und ein optimaler Anpressdruck sorgen dafür, dass sie auch nach stundenlangem Hören nicht stören oder drücken. Die passive Geräuschminimierung dämpft Umgebungsgeräusche effektiv, ohne den Klang zu verfälschen. Hinzu kommt eine hochwertige Verarbeitung, die sowohl robust als auch edel wirkt. Für mich sind die DT 1770 PRO MKII ein echtes Upgrade – egal ob fürs Studio oder den Musikgenuss zu Hause.

headline.text:
DT 1770 PRO MKII
THE EVOLUTION OF A STUDIO LEGEND

variables.mainText: Take your recordings and tracks to the next level thanks to improved sound, enhanced comfort and industry-leading workmanship. The German-made DT 1770 PRO MKII is our new flagship of closed-back studio headphones. The premium model features the newly developed TESLA.45 driver technology. Suitable for recording, monitoring and editing, they are the first choice for discerning users who do not wish to compromise in their day-to-day work.

spots.tooltipText: High wearing comfort thanks to fontanelle recess
New TESLA.45 driver: Excellent resolution & extremely low distortion
For recording, monitoring & editing thanks to closed-back design
Soft & breathable velour ear pads for long studio sessions

variables.mainText: Thanks to their closed-back design, the DT 1770 PRO MKII offers a high level of sound insulation. Suitable for professional recording, monitoring and editing, the premium headphones perform impressively as reference headphones both in everyday studio work and in loud live environments. The lively sound profile is characterized by powerful bass, natural mids and detailed highs.

cite.text: It is particularly important both in the vocal cabin and when recording instruments that the artist feels comfortable”, stresses Product Manager Kevin Nietsch. “This often intangible aspect can turn a good track into an excellent one”, continues Nietsch. “The DT 1770 PRO MKII therefore has a sound profile that is fun, but at the same time always remains detailed and precise.

variables.mainText:
The DT 1770 PRO MKII feature the latest generation of TESLA driver technology TESLA.45. Redesigned from the ground up, the 45mm driver system boasts an excellent resolution, extremely low distortion and outstanding impulse behaviour. The TESLA.45 provides signal fidelity even at high volumes. Our engineers have managed to combine studio-sound and flexibility thanks to weight-optimized materials. The DT 1770 PRO MKII has an impedance of 30 ohms, which means that the studio headphones can be used with a variety of end devices.

When it comes to sound, the premium model boasts precise bass response, transparent mids and detailed highs. The TESLA.45 sound transducers are manufactured at the company headquarters in Heilbronn, Germany. Each DT 1770 PRO MKII contains two TESLA.45 sound transducers, which are measured several times during the various production steps.

The DT 1770 PRO MKII is designed for long studio sessions. The robust, flexible spring steel headband design ensures optimum contact pressure. In addition to the velour ear pads, the leatherette ear pads also guarantee a comfortable fit. The headband is made of soft memory foam and adapts to the shape of the head. The new fontanelle recess avoids pain-sensitive areas on the head. Both the headband and the ear pads can be replaced if necessary.
beyerdynamic HEADPHONE LAB delivers the sound of a high‑end studio. For better mixes — no matter where you produce. Free, easy to use, and ready to go.

variables.mainText: Thanks to our decades of German manufacturing expertise, the DT 1770 PRO MKII sets the benchmark in workmanship and durability. Thanks to multiple measurements of the driver systems across various production steps, as well as the selection of high-quality materials such as anodised metal, the DT 1770 PRO MKII is a reliable professional tool. In the interest of sustainability, almost every part of the premium headphones can be replaced.

accordion.text:
Thanks to the structurally optimized diaphragm, the level of distortion and impulse response has been significantly improved compared to the previous model, leading to a clearer sound profile. The diaphragm, made of high-performance PEEK polymer, ensures precise bass reproduction, while the refined treble profile is achieved through a lightweight voice coil made of aluminum-coated copper wire.

The newly developed system combines flexibility and exceptional sound quality due to the use of modern materials and manufacturing techniques. With an impedance of 30 ohms, both models are suitable for a wide range of devices, providing reference-quality sound that meets the needs of professional users.
accordion.title: In which areas has the new TESLA.45 transducer been improved compared to its predecessor?
accordion.teaser: Both the closed-back DT 1770 PRO MKII and the open-back DT 1990 PRO MKII are equipped with two TESLA.45 drivers, each measuring 45 mm in diameter. The powerful neodymium magnet achieves a flux density of over one Tesla in the voice coil air gap, resulting in particularly strong driver performance.

accordion.title: Why do the DT 1770 PRO MKII and DT 1990 PRO MKII have an impedance of 30 ohms?
accordion.teaser: Many playback devices lack the output voltage necessary for driving high-impedance headphones. The lower impedance of these models increases versatility, allowing them to perform well with various devices.

accordion.title: How do the two ear pad sets of the DT 1770 PRO MKII differ?
accordion.teaser: The velour ear pads offer the usual high level of comfort and balanced sound. The leatherette ear pads offer a high level of external sound insulation.

accordion.title: How does the sound signature differ from the DT 1770 PRO to the DT 1770 PRO MKII?
accordion.teaser: The DT 1770 PRO MKII builds on the sound of its predecessor but with enhancements in key areas. The bass is more prominent, mids are clear and transparent, and highs are detailed. The high-frequency range has been fine-tuned for a more balanced sound across the entire spectrum.

faqData.question: In which areas has the new TESLA.45 transducer been improved compared to its predecessor?
faqData.answer:
Both the closed-back DT 1770 PRO MKII and the open-back DT 1990 PRO MKII are equipped with two TESLA.45 drivers, each measuring 45 mm in diameter. The powerful neodymium magnet achieves a flux density of over one Tesla in the voice coil air gap, resulting in particularly strong driver performance.

Thanks to the structurally optimized diaphragm, the level of distortion and impulse response has been significantly improved compared to the previous model, leading to a clearer sound profile. The diaphragm, made of high-performance PEEK polymer, ensures precise bass reproduction, while the refined treble profile is achieved through a lightweight voice coil made of aluminum-coated copper wire.

The newly developed system combines flexibility and exceptional sound quality due to the use of modern materials and manufacturing techniques. With an impedance of 30 ohms, both models are suitable for a wide range of devices, providing reference-quality sound that meets the needs of professional users.
